title: Authenticated launch-context prerequisite for scoped provider MCP

conditions.description: Reconcile the production composition gate: current JWT account subject/scopes and selected client routing do not authenticate inference launch/generation, actor/project or MCP profile. Keep scoped provider dispatch held (including generic /mcp as a purported narrow endpoint) until an independently verified existing-auth transport binding distinguishes exact launch and role/profile and prevents use of broader alternate endpoints, and effective provider inventory is independently observed. No new signing/credentials or live provider activation authorized by Worker 6. Coordinate with Worker 12 provisioning and Worker 4/8 execution identity; if existing transport cannot prove it, retain explicit hold and seek Operator direction. Source-only conservative denial candidate under Worker 6 review is not positive evidence.
